notes: Tunisia (Siliana). Table 3 per-ha budgets are survey-based; NPV, payback and Tables 4/6 are DESMICE model outputs (modelled) that count farmer WTP for soil conservation as a benefit. Not extracted: per-item costs in Table 3, per-component columns of Table 4, discounted Table 5, Figures 3/5/6/7 (maps and charts; the NPV-class area shares 43% zero, 56% viable, 40% >6500 TND, 16% 6000-6500, 2% 0-6000 are area shares, not outcome values), WTP values (225 TND/ha mean; 278 large, 78 small farms), not a WB outcome. No carbon income.
